## Risks or limitations / 风险或限制

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] `make check` passes. / `make check` 全绿。
- [ ] Added or updated meaningful tests; explained when tests do not apply. / 已补充或更新有效测试，不适用时已说明。
- [ ] Updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` for public behavior changes; explained when not applicable. / 公共行为变化已同步文档和 `CHANGELOG.md`，不适用时已说明。
- [ ] Regenerated OpenAPI types and rebuilt tracked frontend assets when affected. / 涉及时已重新生成 OpenAPI 类型并构建已跟踪的前端产物。
- [ ] Reviewed the diff for credentials, private data, unrelated changes and dependency-license compliance. / 已检查差异中没有凭证、私人数据和无关改动，依赖符合许可要求。
